en-US.description: Navicat for MySQL is a complete package designed for the unified management and development of MySQL and MariaDB databases.
en-US.longDescription: Navicat for MySQL is a complete package designed for the unified management and development of MySQL and MariaDB databases. It features visual designers for database modeling and data illustration, comprehensive data management tools for importing, exporting, and synchronization, and a drag-and-drop query builder that simplifies SQL creation - making it an invaluable tool for both beginners and experienced developers.
en-US.name: Navicat for MySQL
